comments.value: It is very frustrating I have to use external means, like discord, to tell people to request off me if I want them to join me in a invite+ instance and pray they happen to notice the discord notification. It feels bad and backwards.

Was commented on Discord, but I do think there should be a new instance type for this then.
One that is similar to invite+ but allows others to send out invites.

@{58c6b8ad227a56787575ebbd|full_name}: as Phaxe said in a seperate comment. It seems like this should be a third Invite only type. 
I like how Invite+ works. But would also find “everyone-can-invite-invite” useful too. `Invite++` ? 😅

I agree that this type of instance is very frustrating to coordinate with people you haven't been in contact with during a session, and that if invite+ doesn't get changed, there should be an alternate type of invite+ that allows this.

You know a silly fix for this would be to simply have the invite button available in Invite+ but all it does is sends them a message "request to join me!"
Because this is a silly fix, it demonstrates ridiculousness of the issue further. It's a few unnecessary steps that could be reduced to one.
bruh.. why is this not how it is

details: Currently only the host of an invite+ world can send out invites, visitors can only send an invite if someone requested on them. Please allow everyone to be able to send an invite out to their friends, OR make a new world type that allows this.
title: Allow everyone in invite+ to send invites
